patient._comment: 'patient' contains player-visible patient data and explanatory triage reasoning for Coach and review.

clinical.quoteLong: It's just heartburn — that gas-station burrito had it coming. Gimme a Tums and I'm outta here, I've got a 3 o'clock.
clinical.presentationShort: 58yo M — substernal 'heartburn,' radiating to jaw, onset at his desk.
clinical.presentationLong: 58-year-old male, substernal chest pressure he's calling heartburn, radiating to the jaw, started at his desk.

triageReasoning.summary: This is a high-risk chest-pain presentation that could represent an acute coronary emergency despite the patient's description of heartburn.
triageReasoning.acuityReason: Substernal discomfort radiating to the jaw in a 58-year-old patient, together with diaphoresis and tachycardia, requires rapid evaluation even though most vital signs remain near normal.
triageReasoning.destinationReason: ESI 2 / Acute is appropriate because the presentation is high risk and time-sensitive but does not currently require an immediate lifesaving intervention.
redFlags: Chest discomfort radiating to the jaw
teachingPoints: A patient's label of heartburn does not exclude a cardiac emergency.
A high-risk history and appearance can justify ESI 2 even when blood pressure and oxygen saturation are not severely abnormal.

possibleDiagnoses: (maybe) Gastritis or other upper gastrointestinal pain
possibleClinicalOutcome.disposition: The patient would likely receive an immediate ECG, cardiac monitoring, serial blood testing, and urgent cardiology-directed treatment if acute coronary syndrome is identified.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.who: 58-year-old man in a rumpled work shirt, tie loosened
aiImageGeneration.pose: hunched slightly forward, one hand resting flat on the center of his chest
aiImageGeneration.expression: uneasy, jaw tight, a sheen of sweat on his forehead
signs: hand pressed to center of chest
aiImageGeneration.lookSeverity: insists he's fine, but plainly looks unwell
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a white 58-year-old man in a rumpled work shirt with a loosened tie, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: hunched slightly forward, one hand resting flat on the center of his chest. Expression: uneasy and unwell, quiet worry, jaw tight (not a big grimace). Clearly visible: beads of sweat on his forehead (diaphoretic), slightly gray washed-out skin, hand pressed to the center of his chest. Overall insists he's fine but plainly looks unwell. No text, no logos.
